vendor_statements.Apple: No numbers disclosed. Calif.io built a macOS privilege-escalation chain on Apple M5 from Mythos-derived techniques (55-page report, May); Apple moved to a faster security-update cadence. 103 H/C CVEs in week of 27 Jul.
vendor_statements.Linux: Kernel CVEs per release: ~500 (6.x era) → >1,000 (7.0) → >1,500 (7.2) → ~2,000 (7.3). 432 CVEs issued in 24 h in July. LF names Mythos and GPT-5.4-Cyber as drivers.
vendor_statements.Oracle: Integrated Mythos Preview + OpenAI TAC into detection. CPU CVEs: Jan 158 → Apr 241 → Jun 243 → Jul 1,434 (1,449 patches, 334 products); moved to monthly cycle.
vendor_statements.Cisco: Founding partner; runs Mythos against firewalls, switches, management platforms. No count disclosed; open-sourced Foundry Security Spec. 54 H/C CVEs in week of 17 Aug.
vendor_statements.Mozilla: 271 vulnerabilities found & fixed in Firefox 150 (21 Apr) — >10× Firefox 148 with Opus 4.6. Subsequent spikes: 63 (wk 20 Jul), 43 (wk 17 Aug).
vendor_statements.NVIDIA: Founding partner; no numbers disclosed. 30 H/C CVEs in week of 31 Aug — its highest week in the series.
vendor_statements.VMware: Broadcom: Mythos "since the beginning", built into SDLC; >12 billion frontier-model tokens spent in 5 months scanning Spring/Java. vCenter fixes 29 Jul; 31 H/C CVEs in weeks of 8 Jun and 24 Aug.
vendor_statements.AWS: Founding partner; hosts Mythos Preview on Bedrock (gated). No count disclosed; steady 2–10 H/C per week.
vendor_statements.Cloudflare: 2,000 bugs across critical-path systems, 400 high/critical; false-positive rate "better than human testers". Not a CNA in this series.
vendor_statements.Palo Alto Networks: May 13 "Patch Wednesday": 26 CVEs / 75 issues across 130+ products vs usual <5 per month — first release where most findings came from frontier models. Not a CNA in this series.

framework_facts.note: May security release: 13 advisories in one drop — 4 high middleware/proxy auth bypasses, RSC DoS (CVE-2026-23870 upstream in React), SSRF via WebSocket upgrade, cache poisoning, XSS. 25 Aug: two critical unauthenticated RCEs (AVIF via libheif, Windows path handling CVE-2026-75604). 33 repo advisories in 2026 vs 4 in Dec 2025.

17 security advisories in one Patch Tuesday (runtime, ASP.NET Core, SDK): EncryptedXml ×5, TLS handshake DoS, SslStream bypass, X.509 DoS, HTTP/2 OOM, Negotiate EoP ×2, WPF XAML RCE ×2. June: CVE-2026-45591 SignalR/Blazor Server MessagePack stack-overflow DoS. April: CVE-2026-40372 ASP.NET Core signature-verification EoP (CVSS 9.1). 42 .NET advisories Jan–Aug (Jan 0 → Jul 17 → Aug 10).

Security reports: ~6.5/month historically → 55 (Mar) → 482 (Apr; 370 from Broadcom's own frontier-model scanning across 65 projects). 26 CVEs in April, largest release in Spring's 23-year history in June, 91 CVEs on 20 Aug (Spring Security, Cloud Config, AI, Data REST, Reactor…). 12B+ tokens spent scanning.
Steady 3 advisories/month through April, then 27 in May and 24 in June; 87 in 2026, 66 of them high or critical.

Symfony published 29 advisories in May 2026 (vs 1 in Jan). Composer ecosystem: 59 reviewed advisories in Jan → 288 in May. Laravel framework: 2 in June; Laravel Livewire CVE-2025-54068 landed on KEV in March.
18 advisories in April and 16 in July (41 in 2026) — desktop apps built on Chromium inherit the V8/Skia churn.
The clearest single-project signature of AI scanning: 0 advisories Jan–May, then 33 (Jun), 162 (Jul), 105 (Aug) — 300 in 2026, 21 critical. Gitea code-injection CVE-2026-60004 reached KEV on 25 Aug.

LiteLLM: 42 advisories in 2026, 9 critical, and three KEV entries (May, Jun, Sep). Langflow: 26 advisories, 13 critical, four KEV entries. MLflow SSRF on KEV in August. New AI tooling is where exploitation is actually landing.

Node.js security releases 24 Mar (8 CVEs incl. 2 high DoS) and 29 Jul (high-severity, 22/24/26 lines) — published via HackerOne/CVE, not GitHub advisories. React: 12 high advisories in 2026 (RSC). Vue core: 3 high in August.

~500 CVEs per release in the 6.x era → >1,000 (7.0) → >1,500 (7.2) → ~2,000 (7.3). 432 CVEs issued in 24 h in July; 679 high/critical in the week of 10 Aug. Stable team now uses AI to triage AI-found reports.
PyPI reviewed advisories 104 (Jan) → 380 (May); Go 85 → 338. Starlette HTTP smuggling CVE-2026-48710 (KEV 2 Sep); CPython CVE-2026-4786; Kubernetes affected via golang.org/x/net CVE-2026-39821.

22-01.title: Reducing the Significant Risk of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities
22-01.note: Two-tier remediation model keyed only to whether a CVE was assigned before 2021 (6 months) or after (14 calendar days from KEV addition). Superseded by BOD 26-04 on 2026-06-10; CISA keeps a '(Revoked)' copy of the page.

26-04.title: Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk
26-04.note: Four-variable risk matrix replacing flat CVE-year timelines with tiered 3/14/60-calendar-day windows (or next scheduled upgrade if none of the four risk criteria are met). 60-day deadline (~Aug 2026) to update internal processes; 180-day deadline (~Dec 2026) for full Table 1 compliance. Rationale: AI-accelerated exploitation has collapsed disclosure-to-weaponization from months to hours.
